summary: Expandable sections with a button header. Collapsible is a single section; Accordion coordinates a group of them.
whenToUse: FAQs and long content that users read selectively.
whenNotToUse: Content almost everyone needs to read: show it directly.
Navigation between parallel views: use Tabs.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Level of the heading that wraps the button.

props.name: meta
props.description: Non-interactive accessory content next to the title (badges, counters).

props.name: isExpanded / defaultExpanded / onExpandedChange
props.description: Controlled or uncontrolled state of the section.

props.name: Accordion.allowsMultipleExpanded
props.description: Allows multiple sections to be open.

props.name: Accordion.expandedKeys / defaultExpandedKeys / onExpandedChange
props.description: Group state; requires an id on each section.

inherits: Props of react-aria-components Disclosure and DisclosureGroup (including isDisabled).

keyboard.action: Moves to the next header or to the open content.

accessibility: Button with aria-expanded and aria-controls inside a heading.
Collapsed content is also hidden from assistive technologies.
responsive: Long titles wrap; the icon stays aligned with the first line.
customization: className/style; border, surface and motion tokens (motion disabled with prefers-reduced-motion).
commonMistakes: Placing interactive elements in the title: the title is already a button.
Forgetting ids when controlling Accordion with expandedKeys.
